mapper.insert: INSERT INTO comment(video_id, user_id, parent_id, content, is_deleted) VALUES (#{videoId}, #{userId}, #{parentId}, #{content}, #{isDeleted})
mapper.select: SELECT c.comment_id AS commentId, c.parent_id AS parentId, c.content AS content, u.nickname AS nickname, c.created_at AS createdAt FROM comment c JOIN users u ON c.user_id = u.user_id WHERE c.comment_id = #{commentId}
